cues: The plant you see is the diploid sporophyte.
By meiosis it makes haploid spores.
Those grow into tiny haploid gametophytes: the pollen grain is the male one, and the embryo sac is the female one.
They make gametes, fertilization gives a diploid zygote, and the zygote grows into a new sporophyte.
This is alternation of generations, squeezed almost out of sight inside the flower.
